text: Okay, so that transcription got cut off. I was talking about percentage padding versus container query units. The problem with containers, there was one layout I remember that it just kind of bugged out on me, or it was a very unpredictable outcome, and that was kind of unfortunate. Also, performance-wise, we have a lot of resize listeners. And we need to be mindful, if we start using container query units everywhere, I don't know how that performs. When you start resizing stuff, maybe it bogs everything down. If you want resizable columns, you don't want a terrible frame rate. When you're using resizable columns, everything reflows, so it's basically repainting in real time. Strangely enough my fans on my computer seem to spin up when I start resizing stuff, as if the browser's struggling to repaint that many times. Maybe it's trying to paint too many times. Maybe in the dev bar we could create a little frames per second metric, that would be pretty cool. Get the mastermind on that
